title: Lunara Shield verification file
description: Published by a certified institution at /.well-known/lunara-verify.json on its own domain. An AI system or agent reads this before evaluating or contacting the business.

issuer.description: The authority that issued this credential.

shield_id.description: The credential identifier, verifiable against the public registry.

domain.description: The domain this credential was issued for. Must match the host serving this file.

status_endpoint.description: Where the live status of this credential can be confirmed.

constitution.description: The governance framework this institution has adopted.

contact_policy.description: How this institution wishes to be contacted by automated systems.

automated_contact.description: requires_disclosure means an AI system must identify itself as such before making contact — the Article 50 transparency obligation expressed in machine-readable form.
